key.name: refresh-interval-ms
key.description: How often the lyrics file is read, in milliseconds.

key.name: max-length
key.description: Maximum number of characters shown in the top panel.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which part of the GNOME top panel to place the lyrics in.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Position among the items in the selected panel section.

key.name: hide-when-empty
key.description: Hide the panel label when there is no lyric text.

key.name: show-status
key.description: Show paused/stopped status in the panel.

key.name: font-size
key.description: Label font size in pixels. 0 uses the panel default.

key.name: text-color
key.description: Optional CSS color for the lyrics label, e.g. #ffcc00.

key.name: prefix-icon
key.description: Show the music icon before the song title and lyric lines.
